newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures mixed, June S&P adds losses.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures mixed, June S&P adds losses.

text.p: May 28 - U.S. stock index futures were mixed and June S&P 500 futures added to their losses in afternoon trading. June slid below support at the 846.00 low, but support at 843.00 remained intact. Traders said no notable large sellers were seen, that June was in a slow drift lower after bond close.
